notes: All numbers from Lake Shore (Environment by Janis) CCS-800-205 spec page, brochure (ccr-mossbauer.pdf) and the Lake Shore cryostat selection guide, which lists the entire CCR line including CCS-800 as Gifford-McMahon cryocoolers. The -205 cold head is bottom-mounted; the sample is top-loaded into static He exchange gas in a 38 mm ID tube (tube must be evacuated above 150 K). Vibration: typical line broadening 0.01 mm/s; CCR on/off linewidth 0.241 vs 0.234 mm/s on 25 um Fe foil. Pneumatically isolated stand with lead shielding (327 kg). Cooldown 2.5 h; stability +/-50 mK. Height is an adjustable 142-168 cm range: upper bound recorded. The SHI RDK-205D is the commonly assumed '-205' GM cold head but Lake Shore does not state the make, so it is not asserted here.
